option_scope_note: 1060 nm, 1064 nm and 1072 nm are distinct nominal wavelength options, not interchangeable labels or verified outputs of any product.

wavelengths.title: Visible blue spectrum
wavelengths.research_context: Studied in selected acne-focused light devices. This is not a general skin-treatment claim or a confirmed capability of every product.
wavelengths.use_considerations: Use only a device intended for the application, with its specified eye protection and exposure instructions.
wavelengths.oem_considerations: Discuss a dedicated beauty platform and its optical safety requirements.

wavelengths.title: 480 nm blue-light development option
wavelengths.research_context: A visible blue wavelength requested for custom product development. Define the intended application and evaluate supporting evidence for the exact device before making benefit claims.
wavelengths.use_considerations: Use only the confirmed model’s instructions for exposure, distance and eye protection. A 415 nm protocol must not be assumed to apply to 480 nm.
wavelengths.oem_considerations: Confirm 480 nm LED availability, spectral tolerance, optical safety and channel control with our engineering team.

wavelengths.title: Visible amber spectrum
wavelengths.research_context: An exploratory option for beauty-focused product development. Evidence and intended claims need application-specific review.
wavelengths.use_considerations: Do not infer a treatment time or outcome from color alone. Obtain the exact model’s validated instructions.
wavelengths.oem_considerations: Confirm LED sourcing, spectral tolerance and intended-use evidence before sampling.

wavelengths.title: Visible red spectrum
wavelengths.research_context: Red-light research includes skin appearance and photobiomodulation. Effects cannot be attributed to wavelength alone.
wavelengths.use_considerations: For skin-oriented devices, follow model-specific distance, duration and eye-protection instructions.
wavelengths.oem_considerations: Discuss surface coverage, spectral distribution and controls for a skin-focused platform.

wavelengths.title: A versatile red-light starting point
wavelengths.research_context: Commonly explored in red-light PBM research and red / near-infrared product combinations. It is not a guarantee of skin or recovery outcomes.
wavelengths.use_considerations: Choose the product format first, then follow its documented distance, timer and intensity settings.
wavelengths.oem_considerations: Ask about combining visible red with NIR and verifying output for each channel.

wavelengths.title: 670 nm visible red-light option
wavelengths.research_context: An additional visible red wavelength for your custom development brief. Intended applications and benefit claims must be evaluated for the exact product and configuration.
wavelengths.use_considerations: Follow the confirmed model’s instructions for distance, exposure time and eye protection. Do not substitute a protocol from another wavelength or device.
wavelengths.oem_considerations: Review 670 nm LED availability, spectral tolerance, channel ratios and measured output with engineering.

wavelengths.title: Near-infrared research spectrum
wavelengths.research_context: Frequently used in PBM research. Application, target tissue and study parameters must be evaluated together.
wavelengths.use_considerations: Invisible light is not an indicator of low output. Follow the device manual and specified eye protection.
wavelengths.oem_considerations: Discuss independent channels, optical measurement and the intended-use evidence package.

wavelengths.title: Near-infrared configuration option
wavelengths.research_context: Explored in PBM studies, including skin-related applications. Study findings are specific to the device and protocol.
wavelengths.use_considerations: Confirm the selected model’s intended use and settings. Do not transfer a protocol from another device.
wavelengths.oem_considerations: Review wavelength availability, channel balance and surface irradiance with engineering.

wavelengths.title: A red + NIR development pairing
wavelengths.research_context: A common NIR wavelength in PBM devices and research. It does not imply a fixed penetration depth or guaranteed muscle or joint effect.
wavelengths.use_considerations: Use the confirmed model instructions for distance and duration; visible brightness cannot measure NIR intensity.
wavelengths.oem_considerations: Review red / NIR ratios, independent control options and measured output at specified distances.

wavelengths.title: 940 nm near-infrared option
wavelengths.research_context: An additional near-infrared option for an OEM/ODM development brief. Suitability and any performance claims require review of the intended application and exact device.
wavelengths.use_considerations: Follow model-specific instructions. Confirm measured output, exposure settings and thermal performance before defining a use routine.
wavelengths.oem_considerations: Review 940 nm component availability, wavelength balance, independent controls and thermal testing.

wavelengths.title: 1060 nm model-specific option
wavelengths.research_context: An additional near-infrared option listed for selected APTREDLIGHT panels. Confirm the precise configuration and intended use for your model.
wavelengths.use_considerations: Use the selected device instructions; confirm optical output, controls and thermal performance.
wavelengths.oem_considerations: Request the LED count, measured spectrum and available channel control for the quoted version.

wavelengths.title: 1064 nm specialist NIR option
wavelengths.research_context: A specialist wavelength request for custom development. LED and laser systems are different technologies; wavelength alone does not make their applications or results interchangeable.
wavelengths.use_considerations: A use protocol must be defined for the confirmed light source and device, including its optical safety assessment and instructions.
wavelengths.oem_considerations: Specify LED or laser at the briefing stage; confirm feasibility, optical design, controls and thermal requirements before sampling.

wavelengths.title: Specialist development request
wavelengths.research_context: Longer NIR wavelengths are a specialist research area. Clinical performance cannot be inferred from wavelength or penetration claims.
wavelengths.use_considerations: A specialist concept requires a device-specific safety and intended-use assessment before a use protocol is defined.
wavelengths.oem_considerations: Confirm feasibility, component supply, thermal design and evidence before selecting this option.
